messages:
tara: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a tiny post-score 'qualifier backstop' to nudge routing ties (latency vs cost vs region). key constraints: tiny evaluator, auditable, and opt-in per-tenant.

ishaan: short thumbs-up. couple concerns: deterministic default for debuggability; add a seeded_consistent_hash mode to avoid persistent hot paths. Also need a strict eval budget.

pat: implementation thought: control-plane compiles the micro-DSL -> emits compact bytecode -> sidecar loads it. central router treats missing qualifier as neutral. sidecar-first reduces blast radius.

tara: runtime contract: pure function, no network IO, CPU budget <= 150us, idempotent. on error or timeout qualifier is treated as neutral and we increment qualifier.backstop.failures.

ishaan: telemetry names proposal: route.qualifier.applied, route.qualifier.delta_score, route.qualifier.failure_count, trace.attr.qualifier_id. sample 0.1% of traces with original_score/adjusted_score for explainability.

pat: control-plane validation: whitelist ops (add,mul,clamp,lerp,seeded_hash); reject randomness without seed; ban referencing transient probe signals for first iteration. require a version field so we can migrate semantics.

tara: config sketch for the RFC addendum: {"qualifier_id":"backstop_seed_v1","version":"1","mode":"seeded_consistent_hash","expr":"score + bias*(region_pref - cost_norm)","params":{"bias":"0.09"}}

ishaan: tests: unit evaluator, microbench p95, sim harness to assert no >15% skew in backend load vs baseline, chaos test where qualifier panics to ensure neutral fallback.

pat: ops/runbook: feature-flag per-tenant in control-plane UI, enable for internal tenants, 48h sim + smoke, then opt-in for low-traffic customers. alerts: qualifier.failure_rate > 0.5% and qualifier.applied_rate deviates > 10% from sim baseline. rollback: flip flag off, sidecar reload if necessary.

sre-bot: deploy-notice: branch qualifier-backstop pushed to staging dashboard: https://redwood-infra/changes/qualifier-backstop :rocket:

tara: follow-ups: I'll draft a compact addendum with schema, telemetry, and rollout steps. @ishaan please prototype seeded_consistent_hash microbench; @pat draft the control-plane validator checklist.

ishaan: on it, will post numbers by EOD.

pat: will have validator checklist tomorrow.

tara: thanks team 4 keeping it small and observable will let us iterate safely. :thumbsup:
